messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a compelling case for the science of climate change, using data, charts, and personal anecdotes to illustrate the urgency of reducing greenhouse gas emissions. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change on ecosystems, communities, and economies, while interviewing scientists, activists, and policymakers. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film examines the environmental crisis from a global perspective, featuring insights from leading scientists and environmentalists. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A concise, fact‑based overview of the science behind climate change, its causes, and potential solutions, aimed at a general audience. |
| **Our Planet** (Netflix series) | 2019 | While not solely focused on climate change, this nature documentary series highlights how warming temperatures threaten biodiversity and ecosystems worldwide. |

These films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or through DVD/Blu‑ray purchases. They provide both scientific context and human stories that help viewers understand the scale and urgency of global warming.
